items_all.title: A Team of Researchers from Columbia and CertiK Introduce TensorLean for Formal Verification of GPU Kernels
items_all.summary: TensorLean, from Columbia University and CertiK, formally verifies production GPU kernels at the PTX level using Lean. It checked 149 kernel instances, proved 83 correct, and found 38 bugs in FlashAttention, DeepGEMM and more. The post A Team of Researchers from Columbia and CertiK Introduce TensorLean for Formal Verification of GPU Kernels appeared first on MarkTechPost .
items_all.summary_zh: 來自哥倫比亞大學與 CertiK 的 TensorLean，使用 Lean 在 PTX 層級對正式環境的 GPU 核心進行形式化驗證。它檢查了 149 個核心例項，證明瞭 83 個正確，並在 FlashAttention、DeepGEMM 等專案中發現了 38 個錯誤。

items_all_raw.summary: TensorLean, from Columbia University and CertiK, formally verifies production GPU kernels at the PTX level using Lean. It checked 149 kernel instances, proved 83 correct, and found 38 bugs in FlashAttention, DeepGEMM and more. The post A Team of Researchers from Columbia and CertiK Introduce TensorLean for Formal Verification of GPU Kernels appeared first on MarkTechPost .
items_all_raw.summary_zh: 來自哥倫比亞大學與 CertiK 的 TensorLean，使用 Lean 在 PTX 層級對正式環境的 GPU 核心進行形式化驗證。它檢查了 149 個核心例項，證明瞭 83 個正確，並在 FlashAttention、DeepGEMM 等專案中發現了 38 個錯誤。
